response.content: {"text": "A hash brown is a breakfast dish made from finely shredded or diced potatoes that are formed into a patty or block, then pan-fried until golden brown and crispy on the outside while remaining soft inside. It typically includes seasonings like salt and pepper, and is often served as a side dish with eggs and bacon. Some variations include added ingredients such as onions, cheese, or meat. Hash browns can be served as a flat patty, formed into a disk, or as individual shreds, and are popular in diners and breakfast restaurants worldwide.", "ok": true}
